description: Reads one public web page by URL and returns its content as markdown (text, truncated, total_chars). Use it when the URL is known; it does not search (use google_search), and Zillow or eBay URLs are refused free (use search_zillow or search_ebay). Costs 1 credit, 5 with render_js, 10 with premium or challenge_mode, 25 with render_js and premium; blocked or empty pages are not charged. A page not ready within 25 seconds returns a job_id instead; async=true returns one at once. Poll with the same url and job_id; jobs are kept 1 hour. Required: url.

async.description: true returns {job_id, status, retry_after} at once instead of waiting; false (default) waits up to 25 seconds and returns a job_id only if the page is not ready by then. Boolean, e.g. true.

challenge_mode.description: Separate browser mode for pages that answer with a browser verification check. Boolean, default false; 10 credits. Cannot be combined with premium or render_js.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key, 1-128 characters, e.g. "order-42-pricing". A repeat call with the same key and options returns the same job instead of scraping and charging again; the same key with other options is rejected. Omit to start a new job on every call.

job_id.description: job_id from an earlier scrape_url call: job_ followed by 64 lowercase hex characters. Send it with the same url to read the result; polling starts no new scrape and costs nothing. Jobs are kept 1 hour. Omit to start a new scrape.

max_chars.description: Maximum markdown characters returned in text, integer 1000-30000, default 12000, e.g. 5000. Longer pages are cut and truncated is true; total_chars gives the full length. Ignored when max_tokens is set.

max_tokens.description: Token limit, integer 1-1000000, estimated at about 4 characters per token, e.g. 2000; replaces max_chars. Over it, text is cut and content_id/content_url fetch the full page for 1 hour with the same API key, at no extra charge. No default.

premium.description: Fetch through residential proxies, for pages that come back blocked or empty. Boolean, default false; 10 credits, 25 with render_js.

render_js.description: Run the page's JavaScript in a browser before reading it, for pages built in the browser. Boolean, default false; 5 credits instead of 1.

url.description: Public http or https page URL, at most 8192 characters, e.g. "https://example.com/pricing". Private network addresses and sign-in pages are refused; Reddit URLs are read from the public feed.

name: scrape_url
title: Read URL
